description: A toy kitchen set is in front, with the left fridge door on the left and an oven on the right, and several play foods (bananas, an egg, a green lime, cherries, and a red strawberry) spread on the countertop. The right hand reaches forward to pull the fridge door open, then repeatedly picks up the play foods from the counter and places them inside the lower fridge compartment—bananas first, then the egg and lime, then the cherries and strawberry—releasing each item after setting it down, while the left hand stays mostly still near the counter edge.
